$comment: Author-facing reference for Flash plugin conformance specs. The runner (Scripts/flash_spec_runner/schema.py) validates every spec file against these rules at load time; a malformed spec is one failed result row, never a crashed run. This file is documentation-shaped JSON, not a JSON-Schema document.

spec.name: optional; defaults to the file path relative to this directory, sans .json — the id used by --only/--skip globs and overrides.json
spec.contract: REQUIRED. The contract clause this spec pins, e.g. docs/plugin-protocol.md#framing — every spec traces to the written contract
spec.issue: regressions/ only: the bug link this spec reproduces
spec.requires: array of manifest predicates; ALL must hold for the spec to run against a plugin. Vocabulary: exec, sources, sources_warm, sources_live, queries, commands, hints, source_actions, navigation, status, listen, capability:<name>. Empty/omitted = every plugin
spec.env: extra vars layered onto the scrubbed default environment
spec.env_unset: vars to remove (e.g. FLASH_PLUGIN_CONFIG for the config-absent probe)
spec.config: object serialized to FLASH_PLUGIN_CONFIG (wins over ambient)
spec.data_dir: files pre-created in the fresh per-spec temp data dir; string value = raw text, object value = JSON-encoded
spec.parent: "ephemeral" spawns a runner-owned sleeper whose pid becomes FLASH_PLUGIN_PARENT_PID (kill it with the kill_parent step)
spec.host: {"replies": {"<method>": reply | [replies], "*": default}} — scripted host replies for plugin->host RPCs; a reply of "drop" answers nothing; the built-in default is the capability NAK

steps.send: write one frame; ${plugin_id}/${data_dir}/${parent_pid} substitute in strings; generators expand
steps.send_raw: write raw bytes; string or {"$hex": "ff fe 0a"}
steps.send_batch: array of frames written in one flush (guaranteed overlap for concurrency probes)
steps.expect: await the response frame with the given id; subset match; modifiers within_ms (default 5000) and not_before_ms (latency FLOOR, measured send->arrival)
steps.expect_notification: await a method-only frame matching the matcher; within_ms; each notification satisfies at most one step
steps.expect_all: array of id-carrying matchers satisfied in ANY order inside one within_ms window
steps.expect_none: assert NO frame matching the matcher arrives within for_ms (default 500; also fails on an already-buffered match)
steps.expect_host_rpc: await a plugin->host request matching {method, params?}; reply from the step's `reply`, the host.replies table, or the default NAK; `"reply": "manual"` + `capture` defers the answer to a later reply_host_rpc
steps.expect_stderr: {"contains": s} and/or {"absent": s} against cumulative stderr

matchers.$type: string | number | int | bool | array | object | null (number/int reject booleans)
matchers.$each: matcher applied to every array element
matchers.$absent: the key must not exist in the parent object
matchers.$one_of: value equals one of the listed literals

generators.$repeat: {"value": X, "count": N, "join"?: ""} — string X repeats into one string; non-string X repeats into an array
